root_goal: HalluCode를 독립 \section{HalluCode Extension}으로 격상: hypothesis→method→results→discussion 구조, AP Booster를 3번째 main contribution으로 Abstract에 명시, Introduction에 HalluCode contribution bullet 추가. NeurIPS 논문에서 HalluCode가 HalluMaze와 동등한 비중으로 다뤄지는 구조 완성.
original_goal: HalluCode 벤치마크를 상위 티어 논문급(NeurIPS/ICML/ICLR)으로 개선: Bootstrap CI + Cohen's d 통계 강화, HalluCode 전용 리더보드 (Baseline/AP/MARL-SL × GLM+LFM), arXiv HalluCode 섹션 NeurIPS 심사 기준으로 보강 (significance test, ablation depth, ecological validity, limitation analysis)
sub_goals: [P1] Bootstrap CI n=2000 + Cohen's d for GLM/LFM CodeMEI comparisons
[P2] arXiv tex: HalluCode subsection 확장 (statistical significance, per-trap-type breakdown)
[P2] hallumaze_final.html HalluCode 리더보드 테이블 완성 (trap-type breakdown 추가)
[P3] n=60 scale-up for GLM via 3 seed runs (HC001-HC019 × 3, if rate-limit allows)

reward_spec.primary_metric: NeurIPS-standard HalluCode section: statistical significance + effect size + ablation depth + ecological validity
reward_spec.threshold: Bootstrap CI on all condition comparisons, Cohen's d reported, per-trap-type breakdown table, 2+ reviewer objections pre-empted in limitations
